name: brain
description: A graph-structured, spiking, locally-learning artificial nervous system. Rust core, TypeScript shell.

scripts.build: npm run build:native && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: tsc --build --pretty && tsc --noEmit -p packages/brain/tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/io/tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/viz/tsconfig.test.json
scripts.test:fast: cargo test --workspace && cargo clippy --workspace --tests -- -D warnings && npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.test:slow: cargo test --workspace --release -- --ignored --skip regenerate_golden_rasters && npm run test:golden && npm run test:ts:slow && npm run check:traceability
